decision_conditions: Prior to the commencement of development, details of the proposed air source heat pump (ASHP) unit must be submitted to the Local Planning Authority and approved in writing, including:(i) the sizing, positioning and orientation of the proposed ASHP unit;(ii) product specifications and an estimate of the heating and/or cooling energy the ASHP would provide to the development and the electricity required for this purpose;(iii) the expected heat source temperature and the heat distribution system temperature;(vi) confirmation of he CO2 savings expected to be achieved.Reason: To comply with Policy 31 of the Sutton Local Plan 2018
